exec git init -b main
at 2026-08-12T12:00:00Z
env TZ=UTC
exec card init --prefix pin-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential
exec card config set --scope store board.pins.max_count 4
exec card config set --scope project board.pins.max_count 3
exec card config set --scope board board.pins.max_count 2

exec card create --key source:first 'First issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/first-id.txt
exec card create --key source:second --summary 'Second issue summary.' 'Second issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/second-id.txt
exec card create --summary 'Third issue summary.' 'Third issue'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/third-id.txt

# Pinning is ordered and idempotent, including exact producer-key lookup.
exec card board pin pin-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pinned-first.txt
exec card board pin --key source:first
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/already-pinned-first.txt
exec card board pin --key source:second
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pinned-second.txt
exec card board pins
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pins.txt
exec card --json board pins
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pins.jsonl

# The configured limit rejects only a new admission.
! exec card board pin pin-3
! stdout .
stderr 'board pin limit reached: maximum 2'
exec card board pin pin-2
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/already-pinned-second.txt

# Clearing the board override restores the project limit and admits another pin.
exec card config unset --scope board board.pins.max_count
exec card board pin pin-3
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/pinned-third.txt

# Unpinning is idempotent and key-aware.
exec card board unpin --key source:first
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/unpinned-first.txt
exec card board unpin pin-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/not-pinned-first.txt

# Requested inherited context appends only pinned IDs and titles.
exec card show --context pin-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/show-context.txt
exec card --actor hooke claim --context pin-1
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/claim-context.txt

-- golden/first-id.txt --
pin-1
-- golden/second-id.txt --
pin-2
-- golden/third-id.txt --
pin-3
-- golden/pinned-first.txt --
pinned pin-1: First issue
-- golden/already-pinned-first.txt --
pin-1 is already pinned: First issue
-- golden/pinned-second.txt --
pinned pin-2: Second issue
-- golden/pins.txt --
ID     PRI  STATUS  TYPE  TITLE
pin-1  2    ready   task  First issue
pin-2  2    ready   task  Second issue
-- golden/pins.jsonl --
{"id":"pin-1","title":"First issue","type":"task","status":"ready","priority":2}
{"id":"pin-2","title":"Second issue","type":"task","status":"ready","priority":2}
-- golden/already-pinned-second.txt --
pin-2 is already pinned: Second issue
-- golden/unpinned-first.txt --
unpinned pin-1: First issue
-- golden/not-pinned-first.txt --
pin-1 is not pinned: First issue
-- golden/pinned-third.txt --
pinned pin-3: Third issue
-- golden/show-context.txt --
Pinned issues:
- pin-2: Second issue
- pin-3: Third issue

ID: pin-1
Title: First issue
Type: task
Status: ready
Priority: 2
Assignee: -
Parent: -
Keys: source:first
Labels: -
Depends on: -

Log entries: 0
Attachments: -

Claimed pin-1 as hooke.
Pinned issues:
- pin-2: Second issue
- pin-3: Third issue

Type: task
Status: in_progress
Priority: 2
Assignee: hooke
